name: Beam Radiance Estimate
definition: A photon gathering technique that replaces the ray marching computation of conventional photon mapping by querying all photons along a ray (line) rather than sampling points along the ray, using a smoothing kernel with local support.
summary: Beam Radiance Estimate is a photon-based technique that queries all photons intersecting a camera ray simultaneously using a 2D smoothing kernel, eliminating noise and redundant gathering.
